Its axe-like spearhead and exceptional weight give it absolute destructive power.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 30 |durability = 45 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Savage Lynel Spear}} Savage Lynel Spears are [[Weapon]]s used by [[White-Maned Lynel]]s, [[Silver Lynel]]s, and [[Golden Lynel]]s. Due to the axe-like design of their spearheads and their exceptional weight, they have extreme destructive power. They are commonly used in the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and [[Hebra Mountains]]. These Spears belong to the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a series of Weapons created by [[Lynel]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} Being made of metal, Savage Lynel Spears conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, though they cannot burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].
